title: Maintaining an old Austin
author: Les Caramagnols
excerpt: An old Austin stays usable through regular care: fluids, ignition, cooling, brakes, driving and checks suited to the exact model.
content:
Maintaining an old Austin is mostly about regularity. Many models remain mechanically understandable, but they do not tolerate long neglect, approximate adjustment or parts fitted without checking. The right rhythm always depends on the model, use and actual condition of the car.

A pre-war Seven, a Cambridge, an A40 Farina and an Austin-badged Mini are not maintained in exactly the same way. The principles still meet: inspect, clean, lubricate, adjust, drive and note what changes.

Repair with method

A simple maintenance log helps. Date, mileage, parts fitted, symptoms and adjustments prevent the same diagnosis from being repeated. The Austin page helps place the model; our Mini Mayfair shows a use closer to regular leisure driving.
